title: The Open ASR Leaderboard Adds Its First Global South Language
summary: Hugging Face 的 Open ASR Leaderboard 首次加入全球南方语言，旨在提升低资源语言语音识别的公平性与可见性。
highlights: The Open ASR Leaderboard now includes its first Global South language, marking a step toward more inclusive speech recognition evaluation.
This addition aims to address the underrepresentation of low-resource languages in automatic speech recognition benchmarks.
The move encourages researchers to develop and benchmark models for languages often overlooked by mainstream ASR systems.
